title: Lead Price by Category | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Lead Price by Category Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000067987 Overview The Lead Price by Category add-on allows further customization to the lead pricing scheme by specifying lead prices based on member categories in addition to membership level. Keep in mind that assigning a lead price per category will override the lead price in the Membership Plans. Having the ability to set the optimal lead price for the members based on the category they are in will allow for an increase in the website’s total revenue potential. How To Get This Add-On Websites with the VIP Add-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club Purchase Individually: Lead Price By Category Add-On Enabling the Add-On 1. Go to Members - Member Categories. 2. Search for the categories that the admin wish to set a price to and add the amount: 3. Click Save Changes. For more information about how a member would purchase a lead, please refer to this article: Purchasing Leads For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
